Cookies & Privacy Choices

The storage used by this website and your control over optional analytics.

Updated 8 October 2026

What is active today?

No optional analytics, advertising pixel, social-media embed or third-party chat SDK is currently enabled. Self-hosted fonts and media load with the page. WhatsApp, Instagram and calendar links open external services only when selected; those services control their own storage after you open them.

Browser storage and drafts

  • Enquiry and privacy-request drafts: current page memory only; no localStorage, sessionStorage or application cookie.
  • Guided assistant: current page memory only. Reset or leaving the page clears it.
  • Decorative-motion choice: current page only; no persistent preference is stored.
  • Optional analytics consent: used only when optional analytics is enabled. The localStorage entry autixai-privacy-choice holds the choice, date and notice version for up to 180 days. It contains no chat or enquiry data.

Hosting can involve request logs and infrastructure storage controlled by Vercel. See the Privacy Policy for provider information.

Your choice comes first

If optional analytics is enabled in future, a notice will offer equally accessible allow and reject choices. Analytics events stay blocked until you allow them. You can reject optional analytics, change your choice or withdraw it in privacy settings. Rejecting does not block the website, assistant or enquiry form. Clearing browser storage, changing the notice version or reaching 180 days requires a new choice.

Only fixed interaction names may be used by the optional analytics hook; form values, chat text and contact details are excluded. Any actual provider and its storage must be assessed and added to these notices before activation.
